newsitem.title: USA: True North buys German-based Wilkens.
newsitem.headline: True North buys German-based Wilkens.

text.p: True North Communications Inc said Tuesday it acquired Wilkens/International, a German-based network of owned and affiliated advertising agencies in 19 European countries. Terms were withheld.
In 1995, Wilkens had gross media billings of $754 million, gross income of $65 million and 500 employees.

Wilkens has offices in Hamburg and Frankfurt, Germany; Madrid and Barcelona, Spain; the Netherlands; Poland; Hungary; the Czech Republic and Italy. It also has equity interests in offices in the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Portugal and Slovakia and affiliates in eight other locations.

Richard Hedger, chairman of Wilkens; Holger Uhlhorn, chief executive officer; and Andrew Stewart, chief financial officer, will remain in their respective positions reporting to London-based True North Communications International President Harry Reid.
True North, with operations in 60 countries, had 1996 billings of more than $8.2 billion.
Shares of True North were trading off 3/4 to 21.
